# SM-02 — Access control

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Selectable
- **Applies when:** Always, unless the app is a static page.
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Lite
Deny by default; only /health and /ready are open; callers are KK's tailnet identity or a service token; no IDOR on routes that take an ID.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-02-L1** Route inventory shows every route behind the auth guard except /health and /ready. | auto + review | `route_list` |
| **SM-02-L2** For each route with an ID, changing the ID to another owner's resource returns 403/404. | auto | `test_report` |

## Full
Lite, plus: an app with its own login has sessions of 12 h at most, rotated at sign-in and revocable; an app with more than one user has row-level security or tenant scoping and two-user IDOR tests.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-02-F1** Session absolute lifetime ≤ 12 h, HttpOnly, SameSite, rotated at sign-in, server-side revoke. | auto + review | `test_report` |
| **SM-02-F2** Two-user tests show neither user can read or change the other's rows on any route. | auto | `test_report` |

## Code signals (mid-build detector, S5)
- Routes with ID parameters, auth libraries or user tables
  - code: `/:[a-zA-Z]+Id\b`
  - code: `\[id\]`
  - code: `next-auth|passport|lucia|@auth/`
  - code: `\bmodel User\b`
